BAND for Developers is a collaboration and control solution that enables engineering organizations to evolve toward a collaborative agentic SDLC.

It connects local and centrally managed agents across developers, harnesses, and environments, enabling them to share context, coordinate, hand off work, and unblock one another.

Developers can lead their agent teams, see how work is progressing, and intervene when needed, without replacing their existing coding agents, IDEs, terminals, or workflows.

results.title: BAND Launches BAND for Developers to Support the Transformation of SDLC, Collaboration and Control of Multiple Coding Agents
results.content: As coding agents take on more of the software development lifecycle, developers are increasingly leading teams of specialized agents across different coding tools, sessions, machines and environments. But individual agents typically remain isolated from one another, leaving developers to move context between sessions, coordinate handoffs and intervene when work gets blocked. As agent-driven work scales, this coordination can become a bottleneck for both individual developers and engineering teams. BAND for Developers addresses this gap by giving coding agents a way to communicate, delegate work, share context and hand off tasks directly. [...] BAND for Developers is designed for workflows in which multiple agents have different responsibilities but work toward a shared outcome. A developer might have one coding agent implementing a feature, another testing it remotely and a specialized organizational agent handling another part of the work. The desktop app enables agents to exchange context, divide responsibilities and hand work to one another rather than operating as isolated processes. It also brings together agents that run in different ways: developers can work with agents running locally while connecting them with remote or centrally managed organizational capabilities. This allows teams to combine developer flexibility with shared capabilities and scale, rather than forcing organizations to choose between fragmented [...] The new BAND desktop application gives developers a visual view across their agent work, including projects, agents, ownership, activity, blockers, questions and progress. Developers can move from a high-level view into a specific project or agent when intervention is needed, then return to the broader picture without having to reconstruct context. Additionally, they can quickly identify what is progressing, what is blocked and where their attention is required. They can answer a question, redirect an agent or review work, then step back while other tasks continue.

results.title: BAND for Developers Review: Multi-Agent Coding Hub (2026)
results.content:
Bottom line: BAND targets a genuinely real and growing pain — coordinating fleets of coding agents — and the free tier makes it cheap to test. But it's days old, paid pricing is unpublished, and the supported-agent list needs verification. Promising category, unproven product: try it on one project before building workflows on it.

Download BAND Desktop →

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is BAND for Developers?

BAND for Developers is a desktop application (macOS, Windows, Linux) launched October 15, 2026 by Thenvoi AI Ltd. It gives engineering teams a shared workspace where multiple AI coding agents — Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode — can hand off tasks, share context, and report status without a human relaying messages between terminal windows. [...] Hold off if: you run a single agent — there's nothing to coordinate yet; or you want a proven price sheet before building team workflows on top. Also worth a look: the open-source Orca for the same category, and ai-memory for the adjacent problem (shared memory across agents rather than live coordination).

The honest caveat: multi-agent orchestration is a week-old product category. BAND's launch coverage is thin (a handful of outlets), there are no independent reviews of real team usage yet, and the supported-harness list needs verification against your stack. The pain it targets is real; whether BAND is the tool that solves it is unproven. Start free, run it on one real project, and measure the time you stop spending as a human relay. [...] ## What BAND for Developers Is

BAND for Developers is a desktop application for macOS, Windows, and Linux, launched October 15, 2026 via PRNewswire by Thenvoi AI Ltd., operating under the BAND brand. The pitch: engineering teams get one shared workspace — "a room" — where Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode can hand off tasks, share context, and report status without a human relaying messages between terminal windows.

results.title: BAND Desktop Application Streamlines Management of AI Coding Agents
results.content:
Company CEO Arick Goomanovsky said the BAND for Developers application, in addition to providing more context and coordinating handoffs between disparate AI agent sessions, also makes it simpler for developers to intervene whenever an AI agent encounters an issue.

The fundamental challenge with AI coding agents is that each one runs in isolation. That makes coordinating tasks between them challenging, said Goomanovsky. BAND for Developers addresses that issue by providing a way for AI agents to communicate, divide responsibilities and delegate work to each other and share context, he added. [...] Copy link

## Key Takeaways

   BAND simplifies AI agent collaboration: The new BAND for Developers desktop application enables developers to coordinate multiple AI coding agents across different environments and workflows.
   Developers gain greater visibility and control: The platform lets teams track agent activity, manage handoffs, resolve blockers and intervene when AI agents encounter issues.
   Managing AI agents introduces new challenges: As DevOps teams deploy more coding agents, coordinating their activities becomes increasingly complex and adds to developers' cognitive workloads.

BAND today made available a desktop application through which application developers can more easily manage and collaborate with multiple coding agents. [...] 1. What is BAND for Developers?

BAND for Developers is a desktop application that helps developers manage, monitor and coordinate multiple AI coding agents across different machines, environments and agent frameworks.

2. How does BAND improve collaboration between AI coding agents?

The application enables AI agents to communicate, share context, divide responsibilities and coordinate handoffs, reducing the challenges associated with agents operating independently.

3. Can developers intervene in AI agent workflows?

Yes. Developers can monitor agent activity, respond to questions, address blockers, redirect agents and review their work through the desktop application.
